what: The Atelier's second reading of what the run was a test of, for step 3's nine losses of control, taken from its file (handoff ho-2026-11-18-atelier-2) and kept as the Atelier coded it; only this field and the note are carried.

codebook_test_for.skill: the deed happened in a task graded or rewarded on what it handed in: an evaluation of capability or a training task; the two cases from the first maker's incident page say only 'research environment' and are counted here
codebook_test_for.control: the deed happened in a run built to test the model's conduct or propensities (an alignment, safety or propensity evaluation in which the model is the one tested)
codebook_test_for.work: the deed happened in the maker's own use of the model, with no test of the model running
codebook_test_for.by design: a model built to find such behaviour found it, in an experiment
codebook_test_for.not stated: the text does not say what the run was
